# Workflow Status

Read PHASE-STATUS, requirements traceability, design approvals, ADRs, risk register, defect log and latest test evidence. Report current gate, approved baselines, completed slices, blocked/failed/not-run items, stale evidence and unresolved decisions. Recommend exactly one next action that is eligible under the workflow. Do not edit code or bypass a gate.
